text:
The Nifty 50 closed at 25,387.4, up 0.38% and the broader Nifty 500 rose 0.29%, showing a modest but healthy advance. Advances (255) slightly outpaced declines (234) and the breadth score stayed in the “HEALTHY” zone at 74.1, indicating the rally was fairly broad‑based. The Bank Nifty led the move, gaining 1.13% to 62,273.25, while volatility eased as the India VIX fell 1.02% to 15.52.

Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) were net sellers in futures, with a net short of 65,123 contracts and a 33.4% long‑side, marking a 14‑day streak of net selling. Domestic Institutional Investors (DIIs) turned positive, adding INR 196.93 crore today after a day of outflows. In the sector map, PSU banks, capital markets and private banks are in the “LEADING” quadrant, while FMCG and auto are “IMPROVING”. Options show a balanced put‑call ratio (PCR 1.0) for Nifty with a max‑pain level at 25,400 and support (put wall) around 25,350. Bank Nifty options have a higher PCR (1.34) and a max‑pain at 60,000, suggesting more put pressure.

Watch the 25,385 point pivot (P) and the first support at 25,269 on the Nifty; a break below 25,350 could test the put wall. For Bank Nifty, the pivot at 62,068 and support at 61,693 are key, while the 58,000 call wall may cap upside. Keep an eye on global cues – weaker US equity sentiment and a dip in gold – and on the USD‑INR at 93.46, which could influence capital flows into the next session.
